nodes.label: The Cosmic Arcade Design Concept
nodes.rationale: Treats the mobile screen as an illuminated space cockpit window; strips administrative clutter for rapid split-second arcade decisions.

nodes.label: Tri-State Semantic Color Rule
nodes.rationale: Buttons and status indicators must strictly reflect current phase: Launch Green for betting, Solar Gold for flying/cashout, Nebula Crimson for crash to prevent user confusion.

nodes.label: Voltage Color Saturation Rule
nodes.rationale: Limits high-saturation accents to max 15% surface area with 85% dark neutrals so state transitions deliver maximum perceptual impact.

nodes.label: Telemetry Monospace Rule
nodes.rationale: Rapidly fluctuating numeric telemetry must use font-mono tabular digits to prevent layout jitter during fast multiplier ascent.

nodes.label: Tonal Stratum Elevation Rule
nodes.rationale: Elevates surfaces through dark background lightness progression (Void Black -> Charcoal -> Graphite) instead of light drop shadows.

nodes.label: Thumb Zone Mobile Layout Anchor
nodes.rationale: Anchors primary bet and cashout controls in the lower third viewport for effortless single-handed thumb interaction.
